newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Kaifa '96 net rises 133 pct.
newsitem.headline: China's Kaifa '96 net rises 133 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 1.037 yuan vs 0.624 yuan
Net assets per share 2.980 yuan vs 2.395 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Kaifa Technology Co Ltd.
NOTE: The results, under Chinese accounting standards, were published in a statement in Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Friday.
Kaifa, a major computer components maker, has two ventures in Shenzhen with International Business Machines Corp.

Kaifa's board of directors proposed to distribute one bonus share and a cash dividend of 0.2 yuan for every share held for 1996, pending approval of shareholders at an annual general meeting on May 5.
